clause_inventory.quote: Nimbus supplies compute, storage and network monitoring for PROD-AUR. Aurora controls its application code and customer support. A production incident is measured from Nimbus monitoring logs, with conflicting records reviewed jointly.

The term begins on 2027-01-03 and ends on 2027-12-31. It renews for twelve months unless written non-renewal reaches the other party at least 60 calendar days before expiry, by 17:00 IST on 2027-11-01 for the first term.

The monthly fee is INR 200,000, payable in arrears by the tenth calendar day of the following month at 17:00 IST. January is charged at the full monthly fee. Taxes separately invoiced are outside the stated fee. Undisputed overdue principal attracts simple interest of 0.05% per calendar day from the day after its due date, capped at INR 10,000 per invoice. Cleared payments reduce principal before subsequent daily charges; no compounding applies.

For each calendar month, a single continuous unplanned production outage lasting more than 120 minutes earns Aurora a credit of 10% of the monthly fee, irrespective of further duration. Monthly incident credits together are capped at 20% of that fee. Approved maintenance notified at least 48 hours in advance is excluded. Aurora must claim within 15 calendar days after the incident ends; Nimbus issues the credit on the next invoice. No cash reimbursement is automatic.

Nimbus shall restore the affected infrastructure within six hours after receipt of a valid priority-one ticket. Missing this objective does not create a second fixed monetary penalty; clause 4.1 governs service credits. Backup restoration under AUR-2027-008 depends on this infrastructure.

Nimbus acts as processor for Aurora-controlled personal data and processes it only on documented instructions. Nimbus applies access control, encryption and the applicable DPDP Act requirements and notifies Aurora of a confirmed personal-data incident within 24 hours of discovery. No unverified regulatory fine is an agreed contract charge.

Each party indemnifies the other for third-party intellectual-property claims caused by its own supplied materials, subject to prompt notice, control of defence and no admission without consent. Ordinary aggregate liability is capped at INR 2,400,000 per term; fraud, deliberate misconduct and confidentiality breaches are outside that cap. Credits offset recovery for the same loss.

Either party may terminate for convenience on 60 calendar days written notice or for material breach remaining uncured for 15 calendar days after receipt of a detailed notice. Nimbus supplies a usable data export within ten calendar days of termination; the export format is CSV for tabular records and original format for files. No early-exit fee applies.

Both parties protect non-public information with reasonable care, disclose it only to staff and approved advisers who need access, and retain the duty for three years after termination. Lawful compelled disclosure requires prior notice where permitted.

Assignment requires the other party's prior written consent, except a solvent internal reorganisation with no service reduction. A force-majeure notice is due within three calendar days of discovery; mitigation remains required, and affected performance only is suspended. Already-earned payment duties continue. No exclusivity is granted.

Indian law governs. Operational disputes first go to named service leads for ten calendar days, then senior representatives for ten further days. Courts in Bengaluru have exclusive jurisdiction for unresolved claims. Notices go to aurora-legal@aurora.example and legal@nimbus.example.

Aurora hosts resident access, maintenance requests and billing views for Willow. The production application is RESIDENT-ONE on PROD-AUR. Willow remains responsible for resident notices and lawful collection of data.

Service starts on 2027-01-10 and continues through 2027-12-31. Automatic renewal is for twelve months unless either party gives written notice at least 30 calendar days before expiry, by 17:00 IST on 2027-12-01 in the first term.

Willow owes Aurora INR 120,000 per calendar month, including January, payable in arrears by 17:00 IST on the seventh day of the following month. The invoice is issued on month end. Undisputed overdue principal bears simple interest of 1% per month, prorated using a 30-day month from the day after the due date; the cap is INR 6,000 per invoice. Payment applies to principal first.

A continuous customer-visible outage exceeding 30 minutes earns Willow a credit of 5% of the monthly subscription fee per incident. Aggregate credits are capped at 15% of the monthly fee. Planned infrastructure maintenance is not excluded from this promise. Willow must claim within ten calendar days after the incident ends. Aurora issues approved credits on the next invoice and must not count a repeated incident report twice.

Aurora shall keep a staffed support desk operating from UNIT-A at Willow's premises throughout the subscription term. Relocation requires Willow's written consent. The office lease AUR-2027-005 is a separate agreement and does not extend automatically with this order.

Willow is controller and Aurora is processor of resident personal data. Aurora follows documented instructions, restricts access and notifies Willow within 12 hours of a confirmed breach. The parties comply with applicable DPDP requirements; GDPR applies only to processing within its actual scope. Data is not licensed for unrelated model training.

Aurora indemnifies Willow against third-party IP infringement claims arising from the portal, subject to control of defence and cooperation. Willow indemnifies Aurora for unlawful resident content provided by Willow under the same procedure. Ordinary aggregate liability is INR 1,440,000 per term; fraud and deliberate misconduct are uncapped. Service credits offset damages for the same loss.

Either party may end for convenience on 45 calendar days written notice or for material breach not cured within 15 calendar days of a detailed notice. Prepaid fees for undelivered service are refunded pro rata; no punitive exit fee is agreed. Aurora provides an export within ten calendar days after exit.

Non-public commercial and resident information remains confidential during the term and for three years after exit. Necessary staff and advisers must be bound by equivalent duties. Statutory retention is permitted with access restricted.

Assignment requires written consent and does not release existing obligations without a novation. Force majeure excuses only affected performance while notified and mitigated; the claiming party must notify within three days of discovery. There is no exclusivity or employee non-compete.

Indian law governs and Bengaluru courts have exclusive jurisdiction after ten calendar days of senior-level negotiation. Notices are sent to aurora-legal@aurora.example and legal@willow.example. This order does not vary the hosting vendor's separate credit thresholds.

clause_inventory.quote: UNIT-A consists of the furnished support office in Willow's Bengaluru property. Aurora may operate its resident portal support desk there. Residential occupation and subletting without Willow's written consent are prohibited.

The deposit cannot silently be applied to monthly rent.

Cleared rent payments apply first to that month's unpaid principal. Each monthly rent invoice has a grace period ending at 23:59:59 IST on the tenth calendar day of that month. From the eleventh day through each evaluation or clearing date inclusive, simple late rent charges accrue at 0.1% of unpaid principal per calendar date, capped at INR 5,000 per monthly invoice. No interest accrues on interest or on an already paid amount.

Aurora shall return keys and vacant possession by 17:00 IST on 2027-06-30. Unauthorised occupation from 2027-07-01 incurs INR 5,000 per calendar date until actual hand-back, capped at INR 50,000. Payment of this charge does not grant a renewed tenancy. Future intended use is not proof of actual holdover.

Willow maintains structure and building systems; Aurora repairs damage caused by its negligence, excluding ordinary wear. Willow insures the building and Aurora insures its equipment. Urgent building hazards shall be acknowledged within four hours of a valid ticket; no fixed SLA credit is specified.

Ordinary aggregate contractual liability is INR 600,000, excluding unpaid rent, refundable deposit, fraud and deliberate misconduct. Duplicate recovery for the same damage is prohibited.

Rent is payable only through effective hand-back or termination as applicable; accrued charges survive. The deposit accounting must identify each deduction.

Willow permits peaceful use subject to lawful inspection on 24 hours notice except emergencies. Access records and business information remain confidential for three years after exit. Each party follows applicable safety, fire and personal-data requirements.

Assignment and subletting require Willow's prior consent. Force majeure requires notice within three calendar days and mitigation; rent is abated only for days the entire unit is certified uninhabitable by the competent authority. No exclusivity or non-compete is imposed.

Indian law applies and Bengaluru courts have exclusive jurisdiction after ten calendar days of negotiation. Notices go to aurora-legal@aurora.example and legal@willow.example. Oral assurances cannot amend the fixed end date.
